ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   B. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.

   A. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   C. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
